an4.243:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an4.243:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca :
an4.243:1.3: Api nu taṃ Ānanda adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasantan ti?
an4.243:1.5: Āyasmato bhante Anuruddhassa Bāhiyo nāma saddhivihārī kevalakappaṃ saṅghabhedāya ṭhito.
an4.243:1.6: Tathāyasmā Anuruddho na ekavācikam pi bhaṇitabbaṃ maññatīti.
an4.243:2.1: Kadā pan' Ānanda Anuruddho saṅghamajjhe adhikaraṇesu vo yuñjati.
an4.243:2.2: Na nu Ānanda yāni kānici adhikaraṇāni uppajjanti sabbāni tāni tumhe c' eva vūpasametha Sāriputta-Moggallānā ca. 2.
an4.243:3.1: Cattāro 'me Ānanda atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:3.3: Idh' Ānanda pāpabhikkhu dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassara-samācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antoputī avassuto kasambujāto.
an4.243:3.6: dussīlo pāpadhammo asuci . . . kasambujāto ti samaggā maṃ santā nāsessanti,
an4.243:3.7: vaggā pana maṃ na nāsessanti ti.
an4.243:3.8: Idaṃ Ānanda paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati. 3.
an4.243:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antagāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato.
an4.243:4.4: micchādiṭṭhiko antagāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato ti samaggā maṃ santā nāssessanti,
an4.243:4.6: Idaṃ Ānanda dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati. 4.
an4.243:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchājīvo hoti micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti.
an4.243:5.4: micchā-ājīvo micchā-ājivena jīvitaṃ kappetīti samaggā maṃ santā nāssessanti, vaggā pana maṃ na nāsessanti.
an4.243:5.6: Idaṃ Ānanda tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati. 5.
an4.243:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda pāpabhikkhu lābhakāmo sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo.
an4.243:6.4: lābhakāmo sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo ti samaggā maṃ santā na sakkarissanti na garukarissanti na mānessanti na pūjessanti,
an4.243:6.5: vaggā pana maṃ sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessantī ti.
an4.243:6.6: Idaṃ Ānanda catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:6.7: Ime kho Ānanda cattāro atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandatīti. 242. 1.
